g.text: Phase 1: CMS Base Onboarding & Network Delegation
Confirm App Info & Verify App JWKS (https://bpbuddy.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json)
Issue CMS App Base Statement (CMS_App_Statement for https://library.medicare.gov/apps/bpbuddy)
Verify CMS Signature & Confirm Network Standing
Phase 2: OpenID Federation Dynamic Registration & Token Exchange
POST /token { grant_type: token-exchange, subject_token, trust_chain, client_assertion }
Validate 3-Tier Trust Chain (CMS Root Anchor -> Network -> App)
Verify App Key Possession via client_assertion against App jwks_uri
Validate Linear 3-Tier Trust Chain (CMS Root Anchor -> Network -> App)
